Freedom Five #801: Itsy Bitsy Spider Bots

 

Megalopolis has seen better days. Quite a few of them. Although the city survived the rampage of OblivAeon, it hasn't escaped unscathed. The area around Freedom Tower, more accurately where Freedom Tower used to be, took the heaviest beating but the rest of the city wasn't left untouched by the cosmic entity.

The government science teams are still picking through the wreckage, searching for anything that might have survived. Still wearing radiation suits against any lingering radiation, they're poring over the rubble.

Over your radios, you hear firefighter chatter as they deal with a still burning building on 5th Street, ambulances wailing as they head to 7th where a family has been pulled from the wreckage.

Still, despite this, the city remains as it always has, locals helping out, digging through shattered homes for survivors, arriving on scene with hot food for the rescue workers and firefighters, or meeting under the titanic boughs of Akash'Flora in what used to be Freedom Park and is now a city block-sized tree that other scientist teams are trying to understand.

RevoCorp has even sent the leader of their new team, the Paradigms, to help. She's due in today and it will be good to meet up with your old intern.

 

So, heroes, what are you doing?

Unity muses, half to herself.  She quickly repurposes her scrap metal yet again, giving herself floating stepping stones to climb up on the Bunker Suit's shoulder.  "Tyler, you mind doing the walking for me?  I have to focus to use my powers, so if I'm doing that and trying to find a way to track this Void-thingy at the same time... well, I'd prefer to be on a solid surface and not, y' know, in free-fall."

posts.name: pwatson1974
posts.cooked:
You step through the portal and into the Void. A purple sky flashes with incandescent lightning overhead, the black rock under your feet crumbling with each step, the shards spiralling down, only to arc up into the air, foriming a halo of black stone chips around the winding stone bridge.

As you advance cautiously some of the chips cackle and leap from the halo, sprouting bat-like wings and tiny claws, flitting around Unity, tugging at her hair. (Environment Effect: Hinder using Min dice: 0, 2, 6. Hinder -1 to Unity's next action)

A shadowy figure appears on the bridge, almost growing out of the stone. It looks a lot like a stoney Bunker suit, purple light glinting in its optical sensors as it blocsk your path. It raises one gauntleted fist, the fingers folding inwards until a swordblade replaces the hand. It points this towards you in silent challenge.

posts.name: MindWanderer
posts.cooked:
"Ick, ick, ick!  Get 'em off me!" Unity slaps at her hair to try to get all the rock-bat-void things out, then sees the shadowy Bunker doppelganger.  She looks down at the crumbling ground of the bridge, then slides down off the Bunker suit with a sigh, the black gravel crunching beneath her feet but not giving way.

"You got this, Tyler!  Go get 'em!  I'll, er, be back here."  She plucks another winged rock out of her hair and takes a close look at it.  "Hmm... this gives me an idea."

Unity throws her arms wide.  Pink lightning shoots from her fingers into the stone of the bridge and the flying chips, and some of the pebbles begin to transform, growing wings of their own.  (Principle of Levity: Robotics 3, Banter 3, Green 8, -1 = 7, success with a minor twist)

Instead of being bat-like, however, these stone robots resemble black-and-pink flying monkeys, each only a few inches tall.  They scatter in all directions as Unity cackles with over-the-top glee.  "Fly!  Fly, my pretties!  Eh he he he!  Bring me the little girl!  Or whatever's after the little girl!  Or just, y' know, something interesting!  Eh he he... he?"

A bolt of lime-green energy, the exact color opposite of Unity's signature magenta, lances out of the darkness and disintegrates one of the monkeys as it starts to leave.  The source of the energy coalesces into a shadowy copy of Unity herself, floating on a rock that crackles with green lightning and looking very unhappy.

"Oops.  Not that little girl!  Keep going!  Try again!"

(Summary: the flying monkeys will succeed in helping us progress, but Dark Unity, a d6 minion, joins the fray.  Fortunately she counts as a new minion group and won't act until round 2.)

“Huh. That’s a whole lot of void between us and there. And there’s not a lot to work with…” Unity looks around, seeing nothing but emptiness to any side, except the ziggurat in the distance. Finally she looks to the bridge under their feet. “Well, I guess there’s that.”

She gestures downward, and the entire section of the bridge is enveloped in pink light. It shudders, then detaches, growing a vaguely avian head, wings, and feet. With a hideous cry, it takes flight, making rapid pace toward the strange structure, with all the heroes and their doppelgangers on its back.

“Woohoo! That worked better than I hoped!” As she turns to grin at her friends, though, the bird’s eyes flicker purple, and the head stretches back and bites her, hard!

“Owwww! Leggo!” Surprisingly, it obeys and continues its flight as though uninterrupted.

“Right, ‘strong mind.’ I guess I have to keep my focus here. Ugh, lesson learned.”

(Principle of the Gearhead: Robotics 3, Creativity 1, Green 6. Pass with a minor twist, which is take 6 damage. Now at 20/26 (yellow).)
